cue: Add a Wi-Fi smart plug that supports local control
lesson: Pair in the vendor app, enable local control, add the device to Home Assistant, then verify the state round-trip.
evidence: Reproduced on two units with firmware 1.0.4; toggled 20 times without a miss.
author: ed25519:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
preconditions: Plug and hub are on the same VLAN
Vendor app account is already signed in
steps: Put the plug in pairing mode per the vendor guide.
Complete pairing in the vendor app, then enable local control if present.
Add the device to Home Assistant using the vendor integration.
Toggle the entity and confirm the physical plug switches.
verification: Entity state follows the physical plug within 3 seconds in both directions.
limits: Cloud-only firmware may block local control; stop and use the vendor cloud integration instead.
